_note: How an answer in Slovene is compared with the accepted ones (data/Grading.kt, Spelling). Each rule is [a regular expression, its replacement], applied in order to the lowercased answer without punctuation. same: spellings that are the same answer (correct). fold: letters a keyboard may lack; an answer that differs only in them is almost right, with fold_hint. loose: after fold; an answer that differs only there is almost right, with loose_hint. Hints: diacritics, accent, umlaut, apostrophe, none. drop_subject: the language leaves its subject out where the verb's ending says the person (Spita v šotoru.): a worksheet's person in brackets may be left out of the answer (data/Sheets.kt, withoutPerson). wrong (optional): regular expressions of words that are a known mistake (Italian's anderò for andrò), each matched whole against a word of the answer as fold writes it: such a word one letter off the right one is wrong, never forgiven as a slip in the stem; an entry { "word": …, "for": … } is one only where the right word matches for too (Italian's articulated prepositions: delle for dalle, while della for bella stays a slip). ending_swaps (optional): pairs [the right word's ending, the typed one's], an ending typed for another on the same stem (Italian's dormono for dormano, parlate for parliate, sarete for sareste): wrong, hint ending, never a slip in the stem. wrong: a prefixed verb's form one letter off another prefix's (B2's predpone: prenesel for prinesel, prešel for prišel, prepisal for pripisal, zapisal for napisal, obšel for odšel): another verb, never a slip in the stem; only whole forms are listed, so a slip inside the root (prinsel) stays almost.
